item.title: Rockstar Confirms GTA 6 Won’t Reach 60 FPS on PS5 Pro
item.description: Rockstar says GTA 6 will run locked at 30 fps on PS5 Pro due to CPU limits, despite 1440p rendering, ray‑traced shadows and near‑4K upscaling.

item.title: GTA VI: Vice City Reimagined on Billion‑Dollar Budget
item.description: Rockstar’s GTA VI blends high‑octane crime with everyday chores in a revamped Vice City, backed by a billion‑dollar budget and a decade of development.

item.title: GTA VI Extended Look Hits 31M Netflix Views in 6h
item.description: The 30‑minute GTA VI teaser racked 31.1 million Netflix views in a six‑hour window, topping charts. Explore the metrics, tech, and industry ripple.
